tagline: Keep your channels moving without signing a retainer.

positioning.ideal_buyer: Small-business owners with authorized social channels who want a bounded week of support
positioning.buyer_problem: The business is moving, but its public channels keep going quiet.
positioning.intended_outcome: A practical, agreed week of social media support

delivery_contract.deliverable_to_scope: A written one-week support plan and the specifically agreed content-management or publishing deliverables
delivery_contract.buyer_inputs: Owned social account URLs, audience, approved brand assets, permissions, priorities and proposed start date
delivery_contract.acceptance_criteria_to_agree: Named channels, number and type of agreed deliverables, owner approval process and the final handoff
delivery_contract.exclusions: No guaranteed reach, follower growth, paid advertising, account access, or posting without authorization

discovery_intents: weekly social media help for small business
one week of social content support
small business social media task help
acquisition.content_angle: Social media shouldn't require a long agency contract to get unstuck.
acquisition.approved_example_copy: Need a focused week of help keeping your business channels moving? Evercraft Social | Weekly offers a scoped $100 service. We agree on channels, deliverables and permissions before payment.
acquisition.distribution_rule: Use owned or authorized channels and qualified, permissioned audiences only. Do not claim posts, leads, conversion or revenue without source receipts.

evercraft_os.relationship: Independent market-facing product, sharing future Evercraft OS capabilities
evercraft_os.module_context: Evercraft OS / Distribution & Clip (integration not yet independently verified)

launch_evidence: Existing exact-price Stripe service page tested historically, with owner-shared buyer-view screenshots. This is not a new live purchase or automated delivery attestation.

identity.signature_phrase: Show up. Say something that matters.
identity.purpose: Make consistent communication achievable for small teams without forcing an agency retainer.
identity.narrative_promise: Consistency is built one honest week at a time.
